facts.text: I received an antique locket in the mail that I purchased from an online marketplace.
The locket is supposed to be from the Victorian era.
The locket has an intricate filigree design on the front.
The locket has a small cameo of a woman on the inside.
The locket is made of gold.
The locket has a small inscription on the back that reads "To my dearest, 1850".
I have been wearing the locket on special occasions.
I received many compliments while wearing the locket.
I am thinking of displaying the locket on a velvet-covered pedestal in my home office.
I have an antique desk in my home office that I purchased from my parents.
I have been learning more about antique appraisal.
I am excited to showcase my growing collection in a way that honors their history and beauty.
I am considering adding an antique mirror to my collection.
I visited an antique shop with my friend Emily.
I bought an old, ornate mirror for $120.
The shop owner told me the mirror is from the 1920s.
I am planning to hang the mirror above the desk, opposite a window.
My home office is a bit on the smaller side.
I am considering adding antique books or decorative objects to the shelves.
I want to create a cohesive look that celebrates the beauty of antique pieces while still feeling modern and functional.
I am thinking about starting a small collection of rare and unusual volumes.
I want recommendations for resources or books to start a collection of rare and unusual volumes.
